mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST is above 1150 and RSAFS is above 380000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy stance reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A reading of industrial production (INDPRO) above 115.0 signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 115.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A real GDP level (GDPC1) above 11600 billion dollars indicates a robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 11600, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market that enhances consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above 138000 and UNRATE is below 5.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases short-term discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
